_about: Pinned inputs for the screen captures. Read by TestCaptureInputFormats in internal/tui and by TestCaptureInputsMatchProducers and its siblings in internal/app, so the canned inputs and the checks on the real producers cannot drift apart. diff.lines is the output of git diff --no-color --no-ext-diff --no-textconv for diff.old to diff.new, byte for byte, and diffTwoFiles.lines is the same command run on diffTwoFiles.files (a file registered with git add -N is intentToAdd). liveReadFile holds the messages a model-driven read_file call for modalReadFile.path sends, and patchApproval those a model-driven apply_patch call sends for its input, each as the live path sends them: a stream decoded by the real Anthropic decoder, whose tool-call start event carries the call ID and name and no input, through the agent loop, adaptTurnEvent and toolExecutor.Invoke. resumeMessages holds the types App.ResumeLastSession sends, in order. toolElapsedMs is the one canned duration, in milliseconds, that every tool completion the capture harness sends carries as its Elapsed (capStampElapsed in internal/tui), so a card head at 80 columns or more draws it; the drift pins in internal/app check that a live completion has an Elapsed above zero and do not compare it with this value. approvalElapsedMs is the one canned duration, in milliseconds, that a resolved approval line shows: the capture harness gives the model a clock (capClock in internal/tui) that moves forward by it on every read. TestCaptureLiveReadFileMatchesProducers, TestCapturePatchApprovalMatchesProducers and TestCaptureResumeMessagesMatchProducers in internal/app hold them to the producers.
